attBesluta.text: I didn't use this garland for Christmas, but in January instead as kind of a "winter white" garland. I have a winter white wreath on my front door and now I have a winter white garland inside the house.
Alles Top, sehr zufrieden. Danke Gruss aus Heidelberg
Very very nicely made, the green stem stuff is plastic, feels nice, made nice and feels like it will last a long time.
High quality, lifelike garland, that can work for decorating for multiple seasons. Rubbery silicon texture. I just wish it came in longer segments.
First time ordering from Vevor and couldn't be happier with my purchase. Garland was as described and very reasonable price for the quality. Would order from them again.
iliked the lanterns, but i don't understand way the prices changed so much.

Easy to assemble, and I ordered eucalyptus candle rings to complete the look. Exactly what I was looking for for an outdoor wedding! I'll simply disassemble them and store them in the original packaging for the next celebration. I'm thrilled and think the price is fantastic for such great decorations!
